GLAD 2 loader for OpenGL 4.6 core (+ GL_KHR_debug, GL_ARB_clip_control, GL_EXT/ARB_texture_filter_anisotropic),
generated with `python -m glad --api gl:core=4.6 --out-path . c` (glad2 2.0.x). Used on Linux and
Windows; macOS uses the native <OpenGL/gl3.h>. Licence: the generated code is CC0 / public domain
(https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad), khrplatform.h is MIT (Khronos).
